name: Hotel Feichter
beschreibung: Hotel Feichter is a welcoming family-run establishment located in the heart of Söll near Kufstein. Guests enjoy immediate proximity to the vast slopes of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental in winter, as well as picturesque alpine hiking routes during summer. The property features comfortable rooms with traditional Tyrolean character and an on-site dining room serving authentic local cuisine prepared with fresh regional produce.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Feichter in Söll provides friendly family-run accommodation with authentic Tyrolean dining, comfortable rooms, and easy access to SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser.
